title: Grim's Stuff
description: This is a silly little mod made by me, adding a new ore, some neat weapons, new music disks, and the backrooms.
body:
This is a silly little mod made by me, adding a new ore, some neat weapons, new music disks, and the backrooms. 

Players may now obtain doofgenium above deepslate, use doofgenium to craft a whole array of new fun items, like phaseblades, saxophones, and salt. 

Craft a Laptop item to get exclusive trades from a new villager profession. 

It is highly recommended to be played alongside Farmers Delight as Rice Krispies can only be crafted with rice.

There are also some new items and recipes for Cobblemon and Mega Showdown.
